categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two strategic segments: urban operation services and property management. Urban operation includes comprehensive city services such as environmental sanitation, public space management, municipal facility maintenance, and digital city management. Property management covers traditional property maintenance and specialized technical services across various property types including office buildings, residential communities, commercial complexes, industrial parks, and transportation hubs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including AI algorithms, machine vision, big data analytics, and IoT for smart sanitation and city management. It develops intelligent equipment such as autonomous cleaning robots, smart sorting robots, and solar-powered IoT monitoring devices. The company also innovates in waste processing technologies including multi-stage separation, real-time weighing, and automated sorting systems, integrating hardware and software for efficient urban sanitation solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies, municipal sanitation departments, large property owners, and enterprises across over 180 cities in China. The company serves public sector clients through government procurement and PPP models, and private sector clients in commercial, residential, and industrial property management. Major markets encompass urban sanitation, municipal facility management, smart city services, and environmental protection sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with a service network covering more than 180 city administrative regions. Key regional markets include South China, East China, Northeast, Northwest, North China, Southwest, and Central China. It has also initiated international expansion efforts targeting Southeast Asia and Middle East markets for smart sanitation technology export.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company functions primarily as a midstream and downstream service provider in the urban sanitation and property management supply chain. It integrates upstream equipment manufacturing (e.g., smart sanitation robots) with downstream service delivery including waste collection, facility maintenance, and digital city operations. It also engages in resource recovery and waste processing, completing the value chain from equipment to service to environmental management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities focus on digital transformation, AI-enabled smart sanitation, and low-carbon urban operation. R&D initiatives emphasize autonomous cleaning robots, intelligent waste sorting, solar-powered IoT devices, and data-driven operational platforms. The company aims to build an integrated ecosystem combining operation platforms, intelligent equipment, and smart services to lead industry innovation and support national carbon neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through service contracts with government and enterprise clients, including government procurement, PPP, BOT, and TOT models. Income streams include fees for urban operation services, property management contracts, and sales or leasing of smart sanitation equipment. The company also earns investment income and government subsidies related to environmental projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading urban operation and property management service provider in China, recognized as a benchmark in the sanitation industry. It competes with a mix of private enterprises, state-owned enterprises, mixed-ownership firms, and cross-sector entrants. The company holds a strong market position with extensive geographic coverage, advanced technology adoption, and a broad client base, supported by multiple industry awards and certifications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 7.2 billion, a 16.93% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 575 million, up 10.40%. Total assets reached RMB 9.1 billion, growing 24.06% from the previous year. The company maintains positive cash flow from operations and continues to expand through new subsidiaries and investments, reflecting a stable growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through comprehensive, integrated urban operation and property management solutions enabled by cutting-edge AI and smart technologies. Its value proposition centers on delivering high-quality, efficient, and sustainable city services that enhance urban living environments. The company’s proprietary intelligent equipment, digital platforms, and data-driven management systems provide clients with superior service quality, operational transparency, and environmental benefits aligned with national green development policies.
